strong: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
gloss: father matches the def; forefather is Strong's figurative range. Suffixed form read against Gen.2.24 his father.

strong: a brother (used in the widest sense
gloss: brother matches; relative or kinsman is Strong's widest sense. Gen.4.2 Abel is Cain's brother.

strong: a man as an individual or a male person
gloss: man matches; husband and each are in the usage list. אִשָּׁה kept as separate-lexeme because Strong gives it its own entry.

strong: a mother (as the bond of the family)
gloss: mother matches. Gen.3.20 is construct before all the living.

strong: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
gloss: land and earth are Strong's defs; ground is in the usage list.

strong: a woman
gloss: woman matches; wife is in usage. Strong names the irregular plural נָשִׁים, so it is an inflection.

strong: a son (as a builder of the family name)
gloss: son matches; descendant or member comes from Strong's widest sense.

strong: a daughter (used in the same wide sense
gloss: daughter matches. OSHB lemma 1323 on the plural form.

strong: a king
gloss: king matches. Root listed because Strong derives it from H4427.

strong: properly, writing (the art or a document); by implication, a book
gloss: scroll is in usage; book and written record follow the defs. The infinitive is H5608, Strong's stated source, so a derivation.

strong: illumination or (concrete) luminary
gloss: light is in usage and fits illumination; daylight from usage day. Gender: Strong n-f, OSHB common, both stated on the card.

strong: a day (as the warm hours)
gloss: day matches; time or period is Strong's figurative use.

strong: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night
gloss: night matches. Headword differs; Strong lists לַיְלָה as an alternative, so citationNote says so.

strong: generally, morning
gloss: morning matches; dawn is Strong's proper sense and is a typed alternate.

strong: dual of a primitive noun (but used in a singular sense)
gloss: water matches. Strong calls it dual in form with a singular sense; OSHB tags plural, and the card says plural in form.

strong: sky
gloss: heavens and sky match Strong's def and usage.

strong: a mountain or range of hills
gloss: mountain matches; hill country is in usage.

strong: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch)
gloss: city matches; town is the widest sense and usage. Gender stated as OSHB feminine, Strong n-m.

strong: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
gloss: house and household or family match. Strong's source says only probably, so root stays null.

strong: tree
gloss: tree and wood are Strong's defs.

strong: head
gloss: head, top and chief are Strong's range.

strong: a hand (the open one
gloss: hand matches; power is Strong's bracketed sense.

strong: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain
gloss: eye matches; spring of water is the fountain sense.

strong: a road (as trodden)
gloss: road matches; way and manner of life are Strong's figurative course and mode.
